instruction: Pull over beside the white bus ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the white bus on the right.|Park beside the bus ahead on the right.

instruction: Pull over next to the large white car on the right.
paraphrases: Stop beside the big white car on the right.|Park next to the white car on the right.

instruction: Park beside the closest white car on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearest white car on the right.|Pull over by the large white car on the right.

instruction: Pass the car on the left, then stop near the car ahead in the middle.
paraphrases: Go past the left car and stop by the central car ahead.|After the left car, pull over near the car in the middle.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.

instruction: Pass the motorbike on the right, then stop near the medium vehicle ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the motorbike on the right and stop by the medium vehicle.|After the motorbike, pull over near the medium vehicle ahead.

instruction: Stop behind the car on the left—correction, behind the large car in the middle.
paraphrases: Take the left car—rather, the large central car.|Stop at the central car, not the one on the left.

instruction: Pass the partly hidden pedestrian on the left, then stop near the large car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the occluded pedestrian on the left and stop by the large car.|After the partly visible pedestrian, pull over near the central car.

instruction: Stop near the large white vehicle on the left, not the dark vehicle on the right.
paraphrases: Take the large white vehicle on the left, not the dark one on the right.|Pull over by the left white vehicle rather than the right dark vehicle.

instruction: Pull over near the cyclist on the far left.
paraphrases: Stop beside the cyclist at the left edge.|Park by the cyclist on the far left.
